name: How does AKN Design Group integrate lighting into a comprehensive bathroom renovation plan?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group integrate lighting into a comprehensive bathroom renovation plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group integrates lighting into a comprehensive bathroom renovation plan from the initial design phase. We develop a lighting scheme that supports your desired ambiance and functionality, considering the placement of each fixture in relation to your custom vanity, shower, and other features. This includes planning for electrical layouts, switch locations, and dimmer controls. Our design-build approach ensures that lighting is not an afterthought but an integral component, coordinated with all other elements, from tile selection to plumbing fixtures, for a cohesive and high-value result.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group integrates lighting from the initial design phase, planning electrical layouts and fixture placement to support ambiance and functionality within the comprehensive renovation plan.
